title: SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.30042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. translated_title: SWAM：面向多智能体3D环境的状态感知世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 交互式世界模型基于玩家动作和视觉历史以自回归方式生成虚拟环境。然而，仅凭视觉历史无法可靠地捕捉真实游戏中独立行动的非玩家角色（NPC）不断演变的状态，尤其是当它们处于相机视野之外时。近期的多智能体世界模型通过联合多视角生成或持久化共享状态来应对这一挑战，但往往依赖外部观测（如地图或场景几何信息）或预定义的状态转移。我们提出了SWAM，一种状态感知世界动作模型，它在交互式3D环境中将智能体状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离开来。一个轻量级状态模型从动作中传播角色动态，而无需消耗已生成的帧，它将运动先验与学习到的、依赖场景的校正相结合。预测的状态随后与视觉历史一起引导自回归扩散Transformer进行生成。
tldr: SWAM通过将智能体状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离，利用轻量级状态模型直接从动作预测角色动态，从而在多智能体3D环境中可靠追踪（包括视野外）NPC的状态并引导视觉生成。
en_tdlr: SWAM decouples agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation, using a lightweight state model that propagates character dynamics directly from actions to reliably track NPCs (even off-camera) and guide visual generation in multi-agent 3D environments.
